svg.text: The same console renders a different rail per access level. Items a user cannot act on are removed, not disabled — no dead affordances.
Overview · Agents · Build · Tickets · Runs · Discussion — kept, scoped
A non-admin never sees projects they lack membership for. The
selector lists only granted projects; unknown project_id → 404.
Enforcement is server-side (BFF authz + K8s RBAC); the rail difference is presentation of the same authorization. Realizes rbac-nav-ia-revision.md §4.
